Senses.Explanation: By what is it verified? Xutang Zhiyu, inaugurating the Xingsheng temple — great mechanism, round response, the way without directions, troops following the seal, generals the tally, the phoenix come to rite and the qilin to omen, the ancestor-intent of the west achieved — still asks: after all, by what is it verified? and answers with a long silence, one breath wordless yet holding the images. Tiantong Rujing, when the great stone drum arrives — the lone blind eye at the crown of the head, the great man's great seeing tipping over the sky inside the jar, the great entering the small and the myriad transformations bestowed on all — asks it and answers with the oriole tuning a new tongue on the tall tree and the plum breathing old fragrance from an old branch. Foguo Weibai, on New Year's Day, crosses out last year and this year, new Chan and old Chan, with one stroke of the stick — all annulled at once, and made complete — then asks, knocks once, and lets the auspicious wind of the six directions rise and the harmony of ten thousand regions flow. Duanqiao Miaolun, returning to enter the temple, points at the three gates: the years he left through this door every step trod on it, today entering every meeting collides with it — after all by what is it verified? — and answers by looking up at the temple plaque: bound to be said. Shixi Xinyue, at the dowager-empress's birthday hall, gathers all the auspiciousness into the moment before King Glorious Silence, beyond the empty kalpa, before news omens anything and the true body is fully displayed — then asks, and the ninth heaven's auspicious air coils at dawn while the four seas together behold her who models motherhood. Miyun Yuanwu, mourning that no one raises the old cases anymore and that only this kind of man can shoulder this kind of affair, grants that there happens to be a proof-place — by what verified? — and claps his raised hands: beat the drum, everyone look. Feiyin Tongrong, at the shrine-hall station of his entry, names the guardian its hedge and the dharma its golden moat, charged at Vulture Peak and unforgotten to this day — and by what verified? watch this one petal of incense burn. Pufu Zhuo, in instruction, orders each trainee to take the life-cutting knife and sever the life-root at one stroke before the beginningless kalpa, killing buddha, ancestor and demon until finished — the least fiber and a film grows over the eye — after all by what is it verified? Guanyin bodhisattva spends cash on a hu-bing, puts down her hand, and it is a steamed bun.
